payload.title: HR organisation units may have no owning module: departments_hr.moduleCode is nullable and documented as company-wide, the enum has no hr value, the update input lets null clear it and the web offers a company-wide option, so these units and their employees sit outside every module slice
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/common/enums.ts:32-41 (HrModuleCode is farm, hydroponics, sensor; there is no hr value)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/create-department.input.ts:35-41 (the module is omitted for a company-wide department)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/update-department.input.ts:14-17 (a null on a nullable field is a deliberate clear, moduleCode included)
apps/hr-service/src/common/module-scope.ts:57-61 (every module slice inner-joins on the unit's moduleCode)
web/modules/hr-module/src/pages/DepartmentsPage.tsx:91-93 (Company may move a department back to company-wide null)
payload.rule_violated: D7 moves HR departments with a NULL module to hr, and D1 makes Company a read-only umbrella, not an owner of organisation units
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-18, release R7.
